options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: dereference_group_members
options.description: Indicates whether to dereference "members" field by details level for every object in reply.

options.name: dereference_max_depth
options.description: When details level is full you can choose the number of levels in the API reply.

options.name: details_level
options.description: The level of detail for some of the fields in the response can vary from showing only the UID value of the object to a fully detailed representation of the object.

options.name: from_date
options.description: The date from which tracking changes is to be performed. ISO 8601. If timezone isn't specified in the input, the Management server's timezone is used.

options.name: from_session
options.description: The session UID from which tracking changes is to be performed.

options.name: limit
options.description: Maximum number of sessions to analyze.

options.name: offset
options.description: Number of sessions to skip (beginning with from-session).

options.name: show_membership
options.description: Indicates whether to calculate and show "groups" field for every object in reply.

options.name: to_date
options.description: The date until which tracking changes is to be performed. ISO 8601. If timezone isn't specified in the input, the Management server's timezone is used.

options.name: to_session
options.description: The session UID until which tracking changes is to be performed.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
